profile.name: Lena Hartmann
profile.summary: Product leader with 10 years in B2B workflow software, the last 5 owning billing and invoicing products for a freight-tech platform.

descriptions: Own product strategy and a 3-year roadmap for quoting, billing and invoicing across 4 engineering teams
Launched AI agents that auto-reconcile carrier invoices, cutting manual billing work by 62%
Built a metrics framework linking invoice accuracy to gross margin; now used in quarterly planning
Write SQL daily in Snowflake for quantitative analysis to size opportunities and settle prioritization debates
Align engineering, design, finance and operations on trade-offs when priorities compete
Run weekly syncs with engineering teams in Austin and Kraków across 3 time zones
Present investment cases to the executive team and board twice a year
Mentored 4 PMs on writing specs and PRDs; 2 promoted to senior
Shipped an AP automation workflow used by 1,200 mid-market finance teams
SQL, Snowflake, Looker, Amplitude, Jira, Figma
Written and verbal communication, stakeholder alignment
